name: Béhanzin
role: King of Dahomey from c. 1890 to c. 1894
contribution: Considered the eleventh King of Dahomey, modern-day Republic of Benin.
image_credit: Aublet, Edouard Edmond, born 1854 · Public domain

checks.lead: Gbehanzin, also known as Béhanzin (c. 1845 – 10 December 1906), is considered the eleventh (if Adandozan is not counted) King of Dahomey, modern-day Republic of Benin.  Upon taking the throne, he changed his name from Kondo.
